import hashlib,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd()
original=root.parent/'gen-v1'
def git(*args,cwd=root):
 return subprocess.check_output(['git',*args],cwd=cwd)
head='fd17d9f1b3931eb2b974b86ccc5a3892da47ba33'
base='138b1356495bb3a2c9b35020240513f8faa84964'
assert git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()==head
assert git('rev-parse','MERGE_HEAD').decode().strip()==base
assert not git('ls-files','-u')
assert git('rev-parse','HEAD',cwd=original).decode().strip()=='399cde39ff4ee82272c7a7700944325c44b36070'
assert not git('status','--porcelain',cwd=original)
lock=hashlib.sha256(Path('pnpm-lock.yaml').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert lock=='2269337714e848fd47cca88f898e6d9fd5f70e276a04061e435546ddc9eb9fb9'
a=json.loads(Path('docs/implementation/v3/m15-artifacts/publication-cut-01/archive-manifest.json').read_text())
assert a['publishedCommit']==head
assert a['publishedTree']==git('rev-parse',head+'^{tree}').decode().strip()
assert len(a['files'])==16
for f in a['files']:
 b=Path(f['archive']).read_bytes()
 assert len(b)==f['bytes']
 assert hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==f['sha256']
 assert b==git('show',head+':'+f['path'])
subprocess.run(['git','-c','core.whitespace=cr-at-eol','diff','--check',base,'--','.',':(exclude)docs/implementation/v3/m15-logs/**',':(exclude)docs/implementation/v3/m15-artifacts/**'],check=True)
print(json.dumps({'originalCheckout':'clean','originalHead':'399cde39ff4ee82272c7a7700944325c44b36070','publishedParent':head,'acceptedBase':base,'unmergedPaths':0,'archivedFilesVerified':len(a['files']),'lockfileSha256':lock,'authoredWhitespace':'PASS'},indent=2))
